name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
summary: Collateral-free business loans of up to ₹20 lakh for micro enterprises.
description: Collateral-free institutional credit for non-agricultural micro enterprises, including activities allied to agriculture.
implementingAuthority: Member Lending Institutions (banks, RRBs, SFBs, NBFCs, MFIs)

criteria.label: The loan is for a non-agricultural micro enterprise (allied activities such as poultry, dairy and beekeeping are included)

evidence.quote: Purposes: Non-agricultural, including activities allied to agriculture such as poultry, dairy, beekeeping etc.

criteria.label: Tarun Plus (above Rs. 10 lakh) only for borrowers who availed and repaid a previous Tarun loan

evidence.quote: Tarun Plus- Above Rs.10 lakh and upto Rs.20 lakh (for those entrepreneurs who have availed and successfully repaid previous loans under the ‘Tarun’ Category w.e.f 24.10.2024).

benefits.text: Collateral-free loans: Shishu up to Rs. 50,000; Kishore up to Rs. 5 lakh; Tarun up to Rs. 10 lakh; Tarun Plus up to Rs. 20 lakh.

applicationProcess: Apply at a Member Lending Institution (bank, RRB, SFB, NBFC or MFI).
